record.title: Validate durable fault evidence and locate native constructor failure
record.intent: Prove fault context survives exit, then locate the stock factory failure without speculative initialization changes.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before execution. Keep all children confined to loopback and all specimen inputs unchanged.

Validate a flushed guest fault journal against a private known-fault native control before relying on it. Preserve full exception context and compare its address with the intended control instruction.
Run at most one stock constructor diagnostic after the control passes; trace only the narrowed native construction helpers and initializer state needed to attribute the failure.
Do not install options, redirect capability or contact the physical instrument. No speculative service result, JNI callback or hardware-value substitution.
Preserve the prior negative runs, frozen sources, journals, hashes and guest health; close on an attributed fault or precise remaining observer limitation.
acceptance: A tested durable recorder and one bounded stock result identify the next prerequisite or observation boundary.
